add-header-element-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Header Element to a Tagged PDF
add-header-element-to-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a level‑1 header structure element via ITaggedContent, attach it to the document's structure tree, and save the file as a tagged PDF for accessibility.

add-paragraph-element-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Paragraph Element to Tagged PDF
add-paragraph-element-to-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a paragraph structure element via ITaggedContent, attach it to the tagged structure tree, and save the PDF with updated accessibility information.

create-tagged-pdf-structure-tree.title: Create Tagged PDF with Custom Structure Tree
create-tagged-pdf-structure-tree.description: Loads an existing PDF, enables tagged content, sets language and title, builds a logical structure tree with paragraph, figure, and table elements using AppendChild, and saves the tagged PDF.

apply-font-styling-to-tagged-text.title: Apply Font Styling to Tagged Text in PDF
apply-font-styling-to-tagged-text.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating tagged paragraph and span elements, and applying font, size, style, and color using StructureTextState before saving the document.

adjust-text-fragment-position.title: Adjust Text Fragment Position in PDF
adjust-text-fragment-position.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locating a text fragment on the first page, changing its coordinates, and saving the updated document.

add-accessible-textbox-form-field.title: Add Accessible Text Box Form Field to a Tagged PDF
add-accessible-textbox-form-field.description: Demonstrates how to create a text box form field, register it in the AcroForm, link it to a /Form structure element, and save the PDF as a tagged document for accessibility.

add-accessible-table-of-contents.title: Add Accessible Table of Contents to PDF
add-accessible-table-of-contents.description: Shows how to create a visible Table of Contents page, build its logical structure using tagged PDF elements, and save the PDF with an accessible TOC attached to the structure tree.

extract-tagged-pdf-structure-to-xml.title: Extract Tagged PDF Structure Tree to XML
extract-tagged-pdf-structure-to-xml.description: Shows how to obtain the root structure element of a tagged PDF and save the logical structure tree as an XML file using Aspose.Pdf.

enumerate-pdf-structure-elements-to-json.title: Enumerate PDF Structure Elements and Export to JSON
enumerate-pdf-structure-elements-to-json.description: The example opens a tagged PDF, enumerates the child structure elements using the ElementList class, and writes selected element information to a JSON file.

set-alternative-text-for-images.title: Set Alternative Text for Images in a Tagged PDF
set-alternative-text-for-images.description: Loads a PDF, verifies it is tagged, finds all image (Figure) elements in the logical structure tree, assigns descriptive alternative text, and saves the updated document.

add-tagged-headers-paragraphs-font-styli.title: Add Tagged Headers and Paragraphs with Font Styling to PDF
add-tagged-headers-paragraphs-font-styli.description: Loads an existing PDF, enables tagged PDF accessibility, creates header and paragraph structure elements with distinct font styles, attaches them to the structure tree, and saves the updated document.

create-nested-tagged-structure.title: Create Nested Tagged Structure in PDF
create-nested-tagged-structure.description: Shows how to load a PDF, build a three‑level heading and paragraph hierarchy using the TaggedContent API, and save the document as an accessible tagged PDF.

style-paragraph-in-tagged-pdf.title: Apply Bold Red Styling to Paragraph in Tagged PDF
style-paragraph-in-tagged-pdf.description: Loads a tagged PDF, finds the first paragraph element in the structure tree, and applies bold Arial font with red color using StructureTextState, then saves the modified document.

insert-illustration-before-first-paragra.title: Insert Illustration Element Before First Paragraph in Tagged PDF
insert-illustration-before-first-paragra.description: Shows how to load a PDF, use the tagged content API to locate the first paragraph element, create a FigureElement as an illustration, insert it before that paragraph, and save the updated PDF.

move-text-fragment-to-new-position.title: Move Text Fragment to New Position in PDF
move-text-fragment-to-new-position.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate a specific text fragment with TextFragmentAbsorber, change its Position, and save the modified document.

create-tagged-pdf-form-field.title: Create Tagged PDF Form Field with AcroForm
create-tagged-pdf-form-field.description: Demonstrates how to add an interactive text box to a PDF, register it in the AcroForm, associate it with a /Form structure element, and update the tagged structure tree for accessibility.

add-accessible-toc-to-pdf.title: Add Accessible Table of Contents to PDF
add-accessible-toc-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create an accessible Table of Contents by building logical structure elements for headings, inserting them into the tagged PDF tree, and adding a visual TOC page before saving.

extract-tagged-structure-elements.title: Extract Tagged Structure Elements Text to Separate Files
extract-tagged-structure-elements.description: Loads a PDF, checks for tagged content, walks the logical structure tree and writes each element's actual or alternative text to individual text files in an output folder.

extract-root-structure-children-to-csv.title: Extract Root Structure Child Types to CSV
extract-root-structure-children-to-csv.description: Demonstrates how to access a PDF's tagged content, retrieve the root structure element, collect the type names of its immediate child elements, and write those names to a CSV file.

set-alternative-text-for-images__v2.title: Set Alternative Text for Images in Tagged PDF
set-alternative-text-for-images__v2.description: The example opens a PDF, traverses its tagged structure to locate all FigureElement (image) nodes, assigns a generic alternative text, and saves the updated PDF.

add-footer-structure-element-to-tagged-p.title: Add Footer Structure Element to Tagged PDF
add-footer-structure-element-to-tagged-p.description: Loads an existing PDF, creates a paragraph element as a footer, attaches it to the document's tagged structure tree, and saves the PDF with updated accessibility metadata.

add-styled-paragraph-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Styled Paragraph to a Tagged PDF
add-styled-paragraph-to-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a paragraph element in the tagged structure, setting its font size and style via StructureTextState, attaching it to the root element, and saving the updated PDF.

align-text-fragments-vertically.title: Align Text Fragments Vertically in a PDF
align-text-fragments-vertically.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, extracting all text fragments, moving each fragment to a common X coordinate while preserving its Y position, and saving the updated document.

print-pdf-tagged-structure-outline.title: Print PDF Tagged Structure Outline
print-pdf-tagged-structure-outline.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, access its tagged content tree, retrieve the root structure element, and recursively output the logical structure hierarchy as a plain‑text outline.

export-root-structure-element-ids-to-csv.title: Export Root Structure Element IDs to CSV
export-root-structure-element-ids-to-csv.description: Loads a tagged PDF, retrieves the root structure element, iterates its direct child elements, and writes each element's ID to a CSV file.

set-alternative-text-for-images__v3.title: Set Alternative Text for Images in a Tagged PDF
set-alternative-text-for-images__v3.description: The example loads a PDF, locates all Figure elements in its tagged structure, assigns a unique AlternativeText to each image, and saves the updated document.

add-tagged-header-with-paragraphs-font-s.title: Add Tagged Header with Paragraphs and Font Sizes
add-tagged-header-with-paragraphs-font-s.description: Loads an existing PDF, creates a level‑1 header in the tagged structure, adds two paragraph children with different font sizes using StructureTextState, and saves the tagged PDF.

add-italic-paragraph-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Italic Paragraph to Tagged PDF Structure
add-italic-paragraph-to-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a paragraph structure element, setting its text to italic via StructureTextState, and attaching it to the document's tagged structure tree.

insert-illustration-after-header.title: Insert Illustration Element After Header in Tagged PDF
insert-illustration-after-header.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, ensure it is tagged, locate the first header element, create an illustration element with alternative text, insert it after the header, and save the updated document.

align-paragraph-left-in-tagged-pdf.title: Align Paragraph Elements Left in Tagged PDF
align-paragraph-left-in-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, traverse its logical structure to locate paragraph elements, set their justification to left alignment, and save the modified document.

export-pdf-tagged-structure-hierarchy.title: Export PDF Tagged Structure Hierarchy to Text
export-pdf-tagged-structure-hierarchy.description: Loads a PDF, accesses its tagged content, retrieves the root structure element, and writes the logical structure tree to an indented plain‑text file.

extract-paragraph-child-ids.title: Extract Paragraph Child Element IDs and Export to JSON
extract-paragraph-child-ids.description: The example loads a tagged PDF, finds the first paragraph (P) element, gathers the IDs of its child structure elements, and writes the list to a JSON file.

set-alternative-text-for-pdf-images.title: Set Alternative Text for PDF Images
set-alternative-text-for-pdf-images.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through all images in a PDF, assign descriptive alternative text for accessibility, and save the updated document.

add-header-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Header Element to Tagged PDF with Styling
add-header-to-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a level‑1 header structure element, applying font size and blue color via StructureTextState, and attaching it to the tagged structure tree before saving.

create-tagged-pdf-structure-headings-par.title: Create Tagged PDF Structure with Headings and Paragraphs
create-tagged-pdf-structure-headings-par.description: Demonstrates how to build a two‑level structure tree with headings (H1, H2) and paragraphs using Aspose.Pdf's tagging API, then save the PDF as an accessible document.

set-paragraph-fontstyle-bold-size-14.title: Set Paragraph FontStyle Bold and Size 14 via StructureTextState
set-paragraph-fontstyle-bold-size-14.description: Demonstrates how to create a paragraph structure element in a tagged PDF, apply bold styling and a 14‑point font size using the StructureTextState property, and save the updated document.

insert-illustration-element-into-tagged-.title: Insert Illustration Element into Tagged PDF
insert-illustration-element-into-tagged-.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, enabling tagged content, setting language and title, creating a FigureElement with alternative text, inserting it before paragraph elements, and saving the updated tagged PDF.

move-paragraph-down-20-points.title: Move Paragraph Element Down by 20 Points
move-paragraph-down-20-points.description: Shows how to locate a ParagraphElement in a tagged PDF, shift its position 20 points lower using AdjustPosition, and save the modified document.

add-accessible-toc-to-pdf__v2.title: Add Accessible Table of Contents to PDF
add-accessible-toc-to-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to create a tagged PDF, add a new page with a visible TOC title, build a hierarchical accessible structure using Div and Header elements, and save the updated document.

extract-tagged-text-from-pdf.title: Extract Tagged Text from PDF
extract-tagged-text-from-pdf.description: Shows how to read a PDF's tagged content, recursively collect the ActualText of each structure element, and write the consolidated text to a file.

extract-pdf-tagged-structure-to-json.title: Extract PDF Tagged Structure to JSON
extract-pdf-tagged-structure-to-json.description: Shows how to read a PDF's tagged logical structure with Aspose.Pdf, build a hierarchical model of StructureElements, and serialize the hierarchy to a JSON file.

create-and-attach-section-in-tagged-pdf.title: Create and Attach a Section in a Tagged PDF
create-and-attach-section-in-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, enable tagged content, create a new section element with a paragraph, and save the updated accessible PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-header-element-to-tagged-pdf__v2.title: Add Header Element to Tagged PDF
add-header-element-to-tagged-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to load a tagged PDF, create a HeaderElement, attach it to the structure tree, and save the updated PDF with accessibility metadata.

append-paragraph-to-tagged-pdf-section.title: Append Paragraph to a Tagged PDF Section
append-paragraph-to-tagged-pdf-section.description: Demonstrates loading a tagged PDF, creating a ParagraphElement, appending it to a DivElement (or root) in the logical structure, and saving the updated PDF.

insert-span-into-tagged-pdf-paragraph.title: Insert Span Element into Tagged PDF Paragraph
insert-span-into-tagged-pdf-paragraph.description: Shows how to load a tagged PDF, create a ParagraphElement and a SpanElement, insert the span into the paragraph, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-custom-tag-to-structure-element.title: Add Custom Tag to Structure Element in Tagged PDF
add-custom-tag-to-structure-element.description: Shows how to load a tagged PDF, create a paragraph structure element, assign a custom tag using SetTag, attach it to the structure tree, and save the updated document.

add-hyperlink-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Hyperlink to Tagged PDF Structure
add-hyperlink-to-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a tagged PDF, creating a LinkElement via ITaggedContent, attaching it to the structure tree, and saving the document with an accessible hyperlink.

add-accessibility-note-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Accessibility Note to Tagged PDF
add-accessibility-note-to-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a tagged PDF, creating a NoteElement, setting its text and alternative text, appending it to the document's structure tree, and saving the updated PDF.

set-pdf-language-for-pdf-ua-compliance.title: Set PDF Language for PDF/UA Compliance
set-pdf-language-for-pdf-ua-compliance.description: Demonstrates loading a tagged PDF, setting its document language to English to satisfy PDF/UA accessibility requirements, and saving the updated file.

set-document-title-in-tagged-pdf.title: Set Document Title in Tagged PDF
set-document-title-in-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to load a tagged PDF, set its accessible document title, and save the updated file using Aspose.Pdf.

add-tagged-table-to-pdf.title: Add Tagged Table to PDF for Accessibility
add-tagged-table-to-pdf.description: Loads an existing PDF, creates a tagged table with header and body rows using the ITaggedContent API, and saves the document, enhancing accessibility.

add-table-header-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Table Header to Tagged PDF
add-table-header-to-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a tagged PDF, creating a table element with a header row, attaching it to the document's structure tree, and saving the updated PDF.

add-table-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Table to Tagged PDF
add-table-to-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to load a tagged PDF, create a table with a body, rows, and cells using the Aspose.Pdf.Tagged API, attach it to the structure tree, and save the updated document.

add-table-footer-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Table Footer to a Tagged PDF
add-table-footer-to-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to load a tagged PDF, locate or create a TableElement, add a table footer (TFoot) with a row and cell, and save the document while preserving the accessibility structure.

set-table-background-color-in-tagged-pdf.title: Set Table Background Color in a Tagged PDF
set-table-background-color-in-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to load a tagged PDF, create a TableElement, set its background color for accessibility, and save the updated document.

set-table-borders-in-tagged-pdf.title: Set Table Borders in a Tagged PDF
set-table-borders-in-tagged-pdf.description: Loads a tagged PDF, recursively finds all TableElement objects in the structure tree, applies a black 1‑point border to each table, and saves the modified document.

set-min-row-height-table-rows-tagged-pdf.title: Set Minimum Row Height for Table Rows in a Tagged PDF
set-min-row-height-table-rows-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a tagged PDF, locate all table row elements in the logical structure tree, set a minimum row height, and save the updated document.

set-table-row-vertical-alignment.title: Set Table Row Vertical Alignment in Tagged PDF
set-table-row-vertical-alignment.description: Demonstrates loading a tagged PDF, creating a table structure, setting the vertical alignment of a table row via TableTRElement.VerticalAlignment, and saving the modified document.

set-table-cell-colspan-in-tagged-pdf.title: Set Table Cell Column Span in a Tagged PDF
set-table-cell-colspan-in-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a tagged PDF, locating a table cell element, setting its ColSpan property, and saving the updated document.

set-table-cell-rowspan.title: Set Table Cell RowSpan in a Tagged PDF
set-table-cell-rowspan.description: Loads a tagged PDF, locates the first table cell element, sets its RowSpan property to span multiple rows, and saves the modified document.

validate-pdf-ua-compliance.title: Validate PDF/UA Compliance and Generate Report
validate-pdf-ua-compliance.description: Loads a tagged PDF, runs PDF/UA validation using Aspose.Pdf, and saves the compliance results to an XML report.

add-tagged-section-to-pdf.title: Add Tagged Section with Header and Paragraph to PDF
add-tagged-section-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, access its tagged content, create a new section (DivElement) with a header and paragraph, attach them to the structure tree, and save the updated PDF.

add-section-paragraph-span-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Section with Paragraph and Span to Tagged PDF
add-section-paragraph-span-to-tagged-pdf.description: Loads an existing tagged PDF, creates a new Div (section) containing a paragraph with a span of text, attaches it to the document's structure tree, and saves the updated PDF.

add-custom-header-to-tagged-pdf-section.title: Add Custom Header to a Tagged PDF Section
add-custom-header-to-tagged-pdf-section.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, enabling tagged content, creating a custom section with a level‑1 header, assigning a custom PDF tag, and saving the updated tagged PDF.

add-custom-tagged-section-paragraph.title: Add Custom Tagged Section and Paragraph to PDF
add-custom-tagged-section-paragraph.description: Demonstrates loading a tagged PDF, creating a new Div (section) and a Paragraph with a custom tag, attaching them to the logical structure tree, and saving the updated document.

add-section-with-hyperlink-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Section with Hyperlink to Tagged PDF
add-section-with-hyperlink-to-tagged-pdf.description: Loads an existing PDF, accesses its tagged content, creates a new section containing a heading and a paragraph with a clickable hyperlink, attaches the section to the logical structure tree, and saves the updated PDF.

add-section-header-note-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Section with Header and Note to Tagged PDF
add-section-header-note-to-tagged-pdf.description: The example loads an existing tagged PDF, creates a new Section element containing a level‑1 Header and an embedded Note, attaches them to the structure tree, and saves the updated document.

create-tagged-table-pdf.title: Create Tagged Table with Header, Body, and Footer in PDF
create-tagged-table-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a tagged PDF, building a logical table structure (thead, tbody, tfoot) with cells, and saving the updated PDF while preserving accessibility tags.

style-table-header-background-color.title: Style Table Header Background Color in Tagged PDF
style-table-header-background-color.description: Loads a tagged PDF, locates all table header (TH) elements in the tag structure, applies a light gray background color to each header cell, and saves the modified document.

add-table-border-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Border to Table in Tagged PDF
add-table-border-to-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a tagged PDF, locating the first visual table using TableAbsorber, applying a visible border with a transparent SquareAnnotation, and saving the modified document.

add-table-footer-to-tagged-pdf__v2.title: Add Table Footer to Tagged PDF
add-table-footer-to-tagged-pdf__v2.description: Loads a tagged PDF, sets language and title for accessibility, creates a table with a footer element, adds a row and cell containing text, and saves the updated document.

set-column-span-table-cell-tagged-pdf.title: Set Column Span for Table Cell in Tagged PDF
set-column-span-table-cell-tagged-pdf.description: Loads a tagged PDF, locates a table cell element in the structure tree, sets its column span, and saves the modified document.

set-row-span-table-cell-tagged-pdf.title: Set Row Span for a Table Cell in a Tagged PDF
set-row-span-table-cell-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a tagged PDF, locating a specific table cell by its displayed text, setting its RowSpan property to merge rows, and saving the updated document.

add-link-element-to-tagged-pdf-table.title: Add Link Element to Tagged PDF Table
add-link-element-to-tagged-pdf-table.description: Shows how to load a tagged PDF, create a table structure, insert a link structure element inside a table cell, add a visual link annotation, and save the updated PDF.

insert-note-into-table-footer.title: Insert Note Element into Table Footer of Tagged PDF
insert-note-into-table-footer.description: Demonstrates how to load a tagged PDF, create a table with a footer, add a Note element to the footer, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-custom-tagged-section-with-language.title: Create Custom Tagged Section with Language in PDF
add-custom-tagged-section-with-language.description: Loads a tagged PDF, creates a custom Div element with a user-defined tag, sets a specific language for the element, adds a paragraph of text, attaches it to the structure tree, and saves the updated document.

tag-images-in-pdf.title: Tag Images in a PDF for Accessibility
tag-images-in-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, verifies it is tagged, creates figure elements with alternative text for each image, adds them to the logical structure tree, and saves the updated tagged PDF.

tag-text-fragment-in-pdf.title: Tag a Text Fragment in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf
tag-text-fragment-in-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, finds a specific text fragment, creates a SpanElement in the logical structure tree, tags the text for accessibility, and saves the updated document.

assign-link-tag-to-pdf-link-element.title: Assign Link Tag to PDF Link Element
assign-link-tag-to-pdf-link-element.description: The example loads a PDF, finds the first link element in its tagged structure, assigns the PDF tag "Link" to that element, and saves the modified document.

insert-paragraph-into-pdf-structure.title: Insert Paragraph into PDF Logical Structure
insert-paragraph-into-pdf-structure.description: Loads a PDF, enables tagging, creates a paragraph element and inserts it as the first child of the root logical structure element, then saves the document.

remove-paragraph-element-from-tagged-pdf.title: Remove a Paragraph Element from a Tagged PDF
remove-paragraph-element-from-tagged-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, checks for tagged content, finds the first paragraph element in the logical structure tree, removes it, and saves the modified document.

clear-pdf-tag-children.title: Clear All Children from PDF Tag Structure
clear-pdf-tag-children.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, access its logical (tagged) structure, remove all child elements from a structure element, and save the modified document.

set-image-alt-text-in-pdf.title: Set Image Alternative Text in PDF
set-image-alt-text-in-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through its pages and images, sets alternative (alt) text for each image using Aspose.Pdf, and saves the updated document.

add-image-with-alt-text-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Image with Alternative Text to Tagged PDF
add-image-with-alt-text-to-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF while preserving its existing tags, insert a new image, set alternative text for accessibility, add a Figure element to the structure tree, and save the updated PDF.

tag-pdf-paragraphs-and-report.title: Tag PDF Pages with Paragraph Elements and Generate a Report
tag-pdf-paragraphs-and-report.description: The example loads a PDF, extracts plain text from each page, creates paragraph tags in the logical structure tree, and writes a change report.

insert-table-into-pdf-tagged-structure.title: Insert Table with Header and Body into PDF Tagged Structure
insert-table-into-pdf-tagged-structure.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, access its tagged content, create a table element with header and body rows using InsertChild, and save the updated document. This showcases building accessible PDF structures programmatically.

remove-list-item-from-pdf-tagged-structu.title: Remove a List Item from PDF Tagged Structure
remove-list-item-from-pdf-tagged-structu.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, access its logical structure, locate a List element, remove a child element using RemoveChild, and save the modified document.

clear-figure-children-from-tagged-pdf.title: Clear Child Elements from Figure Tags in a Tagged PDF
clear-figure-children-from-tagged-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, verifies it contains a tagged structure, finds all Figure elements, removes their child elements with ClearChilds, and saves the modified document.

set-image-alt-text-in-pdf__v2.title: Set Image Alternative Text in PDF for Accessibility
set-image-alt-text-in-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating through its pages and images, assigning alternative text to each image, and saving the updated document.

add-accessible-paragraph-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Accessible Paragraph to Existing Tagged PDF
add-accessible-paragraph-to-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF while preserving its existing tag structure, creating a new paragraph element, adding it to the logical structure, and saving the updated PDF.

tag-pdf-links-and-generate-report.title: Tag PDF Links and Generate Verification Report
tag-pdf-links-and-generate-report.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, accessing its logical structure to find link elements, adding alternative text, creating a verification report, and saving the tagged PDF.

set-custom-tag-on-pdf-table-cell.title: Set Custom Tag on PDF Table Cell
set-custom-tag-on-pdf-table-cell.description: Loads a PDF, accesses its tagged structure, finds a table cell element, assigns a custom tag and alternative text for accessibility, and saves the updated document.

add-caption-to-image-in-tagged-pdf.title: Add Caption to Image in Tagged PDF
add-caption-to-image-in-tagged-pdf.description: The example loads a PDF, verifies it has a logical structure, finds the first Figure (image) element, creates a paragraph caption, inserts it as a child of the image tag, and saves the updated document.

remove-caption-from-image-tag.title: Remove Caption from Image Tag in a Tagged PDF
remove-caption-from-image-tag.description: Loads a tagged PDF, locates the first Figure (image) element, removes its caption child using RemoveChild, and saves the updated document.

clear-section-children-in-tagged-pdf.title: Clear Children of Section Elements in a Tagged PDF
clear-section-children-in-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, access its logical structure, locate all Section (Sect) elements, remove their child elements using ClearChilds, and save the modified document.

assign-heading-tag-to-pdf-element.title: Assign Heading Tag to PDF Element Using Aspose.Pdf
assign-heading-tag-to-pdf-element.description: Loads a PDF, locates the first heading element in the logical structure tree, changes its tag to a specific heading level (e.g., H2), and saves the updated tagged PDF.

generate-accessibility-tags-and-report.title: Generate Accessibility Tags and Tag Report for PDF
generate-accessibility-tags-and-report.description: Loads a PDF, enables automatic tagging, accesses the logical structure tree, ensures text elements are tagged, prints a comprehensive tag report, and saves the tagged PDF.

add-alt-text-to-pdf-images.title: Add Alt Text to PDF Images
add-alt-text-to-pdf-images.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate over each page's image resources, set alternative (alt) text for the images, and save the updated document.

tag-pdf-accessibility-images-text.title: Tag PDF for Accessibility: Images and Text Elements
tag-pdf-accessibility-images-text.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, enabling automatic tagging, adding alternative text to images, and setting language and placeholder text for paragraph, header, and span elements before saving the tagged PDF.

add-tagged-image-to-pdf.title: Add Tagged Image to Existing PDF
add-tagged-image-to-pdf.description: Loads a PDF while preserving its existing tag structure, creates a new Figure tag for an inserted image, adds the image to the first page, and saves the updated document.

tag-pdf-links-accessibility-report.title: Tag PDF Links for Accessibility and Generate a Report
tag-pdf-links-accessibility-report.description: The example loads a PDF, accesses or creates its tagged content, finds link annotations, creates corresponding LinkElements in the logical structure, and saves a modification report.

insert-list-items-into-tagged-pdf.title: Insert List Items into Tagged PDF Structure
insert-list-items-into-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to load a tagged PDF, create list item elements with label and body, insert them into an existing List element using InsertChild, and save the modified document.

remove-list-item-from-tagged-pdf.title: Remove List Item from Tagged PDF
remove-list-item-from-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to load a tagged PDF, locate a list (tag "L") in the structure tree, remove one of its list‑item children using RemoveChild, and save the updated document.

clear-table-children-in-tagged-pdf.title: Clear Table Children in Tagged PDF
clear-table-children-in-tagged-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, checks if it is tagged, finds all table elements in the logical structure, removes their child elements using ClearChilds, and saves the modified document.

insert-caption-under-figure.title: Insert Caption Under Figure in a Tagged PDF
insert-caption-under-figure.description: Demonstrates how to load a tagged PDF, locate a Figure element in the logical structure, create a paragraph caption, attach it as a child of the figure, and save the modified document.

remove-caption-from-figure.title: Remove Caption from Figure in Tagged PDF
remove-caption-from-figure.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, navigate its logical structure to locate a Figure element, remove its Caption child, and save the modified document.

clear-root-tag-children.title: Clear All Children from PDF Root Tag
clear-root-tag-children.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, access its logical (tagged) structure, remove all child elements from the root structure element, and save the updated document.

add-alt-text-to-pdf-images__v2.title: Add Alt Text to PDF Images
add-alt-text-to-pdf-images__v2.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each image on every page, sets descriptive alternative text that includes keywords, and saves the updated document.

insert-child-tag-into-pdf.title: Insert Child Tag into Existing PDF Structure
insert-child-tag-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF while preserving its accessibility tags, creating a new paragraph element, inserting it as a child of an existing tag, and saving the updated document.

remove-child-from-heading-tagged-pdf.title: Remove a Child Element from a Heading in a Tagged PDF
remove-child-from-heading-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a tagged PDF, locating a heading element in the logical structure, removing its first child element, and saving the modified document.
